# Practice Compiler

A Muse agent skill that mines a bounded window of your own work sessions (Muse, Codex, or Claude Code exports) for repeated tasks, recurring corrections, missed tools, and failed commands — then stages redacted, evidence-backed improvement proposals for your review. It never scans implicitly and never applies a proposal: approval produces a handoff record only, never a memory write, config edit, publication, or message. Scans need an exact --since/--until window and repeated evidence (min 2 occurrences). No account, no API key needed.
